meta.title: NAVIAR — Help to understand and follow up public-sector cases
meta.description: NAVIAR is an independent advisory service that helps people understand, organise and follow up their cases with public authorities in Norway.

brand.promise: From the first letter to completed follow-up.
brand.disclaimer: NAVIAR is an independent company and is not part of NAV or any public authority.

safety.title: Rules we never break
safety.lead: We promise clarity — not a particular outcome in your case. You trust us with sensitive matters, and these rules are not negotiable.
rules: We never ask for your BankID password or codes.
We never log in to your accounts using your identity.
We work with you present, or under a written authorisation you have given.
Sensitive documents are never sent by ordinary email.
We never guarantee an outcome or a benefit.
Cases requiring legal representation are referred to a lawyer.

booking.fitFirst: We check that the case fits before you pay.

items.a: No. NAVIAR is an independent company and is not part of NAV or any public authority. We work for you, not for the office handling your case.

items.q: Can you guarantee that I get the benefit or the permit?
items.a: No, and you should not trust anyone who says they can. The decision belongs to the authority. What we can do is make sure your case is complete, correct and submitted on time — which is where most cases are lost.

Never your password or codes. Either you are present and log in yourself, or you give us a written authorisation (fullmakt) that defines exactly what we may do and for how long. You can withdraw it at any time.
The fit check is free. One letter explained costs 800 NOK, and a 45-minute clarity call costs 1 500 NOK. You get the price in writing before any work starts, and we say so if the case does not fit.

items.q: Which languages can I get help in?
items.a: We work in Norwegian, English, Turkish, Arabic, Polish, Ukrainian, Russian and Somali. Tell us your preferred language when you book.
No. We provide guidance, preparation and follow-up. When a case needs legal representation, or specialist review in health, tax or immigration matters, we refer you to a qualified professional.

items.q: How do I send documents safely?
items.a: In this pilot you do not need to send documents at all. Describe the letter in your own words and we will say if we need more. Do not send sensitive documents by ordinary email.
